title: maint.event.v1{kind=backup_legacy_manifest}
description: Phase 8 §8.13.4 — emitted during restore when the dump's manifest is in legacy format (missing migration metadata, pre Phase 8.13.4). Fall-back: skip forward-migrate, run verify.sql against the dump schema only. Notification only.

produced_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when this notification was emitted.

dump_date.description: ISO calendar date (UTC) of the dump whose manifest is in legacy format.

fallback_action.description: The fallback behaviour taken: skip forward-migrate, run verify.sql against the dump schema only.

manifest_path.description: Path of the legacy manifest file relative to the backup root.
